attBesluta.text: I read a lot of reviews on this brake bleeder and I was a little skeptical about it. But I’ve bought other items from Vevor and been surprised and pleased with them, and this brake bleeder was no different. Straight out of the box it was fairly easy to set up and use and worked great. I was able to bleed the whole system in less than five minutes. If there are any complaints would be the pop off valve is set a little low, would pop off at 17 PSi.

Bought it for a specific clutch job. I will use it again. And, yes it made the job easier and will make brake or clutch jobs in the future easier as well. However, like many things being offered to us as consumers that may have been made domestically. The build had issues. Out of the box something with my unit pulling a vacuum was "off". So... I had to rip it all apart to find the internal bladder pinched, hope it last! Once re assembled correctly, the unit works. sitting overnight on my work bench it leaks fluid. that shouldn't happen either but at 80 bucks the design WAS SO CLOSE!!!
